description: Details Thorn Mercury MK2 Rohloff - Retro Green - 610S - New This bike would suit a rider of 1778 mm (5ft 10in) to 1955mm (6ft 5in). Clearance over mid top tube 850mm. This bike would be ideal for a winter commute , we can fit lights of your choice . If unsure of size please contact Thorn on 01278 441505, Monday to Thursday from 8.00am to 4.00pm or sales@thorncycles.co.uk. Thorn Mercury MK2 610S Frame Retro Green and Cream & Thorn ST 700c steel fork -BRG Wheels : Front: Son 28 Dynamo Front Hub 32h, Rims. DT Swiss TK540 29er 622 Touring Rim with C/N side wall -Black - 32 Hole Rear: Rohloff Speedhub 500/14 CC 14 Spd Gear Hub, ex box with disc black 17T Continental Contact Urban Tyres with reflex - 700 x 35 35-622 Schwalbe SV17 presta inner tubes Transmission : Thorn Chainset 104/64 PCD 4 arm Black 175mm, Thorn reversible chainring 47T Rohloff Speedhub 500/14 CC 14 Spd Gear Hub 32h Black with DISC fitting inc. 17T Sprocket. KMC E1 Chain Brakes : Shimano Deore V brakes - Front TRP Spyke mechanical disc brake - Rear . Hope Stainless 8 Arm Rotor for Rohloff hub 160mm Tektro RL520 Aero levers Finishing Kit : Van Nicholas Rohloff drop bars - 31.8mm Clamp -420 mm black Van Nicholas light weight stem - 31.8 mm clamp- black- 100mm SkS Chromoplastic Mudguards 700 x 45mm - Black Brooks Cambium saddle - Black Tubus Vega rear rack Profile bottle Cages x2 Thorn Ping bell No pedals supplied Dynamo Lights of your choice can be added and a charging device if wanted - call to discuss. The bike specification is fixed as this bike is already built, any upgrades would be charged in full and the removed parts supplied with the bike loose, no discounts are available.
